tourist.title: How does it work for the Tourist?
tourist.subtitle: Three simple steps for your perfect getaway, no matter the weather
tourist.step1_desc: A gamified 5-question test based on the Big Five personality model. Our AI will learn your real preferences.
tourist.step2_desc: Every outdoor activity has a linked indoor Plan B. If it rains, our AI automatically switches your walk for a wine tasting.
tourist.step3_desc: Foreign tourists get Zero VAT in hotels and a 9-point refund in gastronomy. Everything calculated automatically.

partner.label: For Partners and Merchants
partner.title: Turn rainy days into full sales days
partner.description: Our AI diverts traffic to your indoor spaces when the weather threatens. Manage your capacity and reduce cancellations.
partner.feature1_desc: We respect your comfort levels. Define your maximum capacity and the system will never send more visitors than you can handle.
partner.feature2_desc: Visualize in real-time the probability of traffic diversion to your indoor facilities. Get ready before they arrive.
partner.feature3_desc: Segregated funds according to BCU regulations. Receive your money in a maximum of 30 days with total transparency.
